_comment: AI-kit sync manifest. See CLAUDE.md 'AI-KIT' section for the authority/override rule this file implements. This is a manifest, not a script — the actual sync tool lives in the structure repo (yabl04k0/0000, private) and is invoked from there, not duplicated per project. Public mirror of CHEK_PROTOCOL.md alone: yabl04k0/1111.
override_rule: A marker directly above a diverging section makes THIS project authoritative for that section only. No marker means the structure repo's version wins on the next sync, silently overwriting local drift. A whole-file override is a marker at the top of the file.
sync_policy: diff-and-review only, never a blind overwrite; skip files with no real drift; one factual commit per sync naming the files and the reason
chek_protocol_note: CHEK_PROTOCOL.md is TIER A and continuously maintained upstream in the structure repo. Publishing a structure-repo change onward to the separate public chek-protocol repo is a distinct, always-manual step performed from the structure repo, not from this project.
